name: overlap_down
body:
Range("A1:F6").Clear
Range("A1").Value = "a"
Range("B1").Value = "b"
Range("A2").Value = "c"
Range("B2").Value = "d"
On Error Resume Next
Range("A1:B2").Copy Range("A2")
n = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Report = CStr(n)
For Each cell In Range("A1:F6")
Report = Report & "|" & cell.Formula & ":" & CStr(cell.Font.Bold) & ":" & cell.NumberFormat
Next cell
